brief.claim: Across participants, grip strength is positively correlated with cortical thickness in the motor cortex: the correlation between the two measures is greater than zero at the one-sided 0.05 level.

data_keys.shape: (10, 2) axes: (participants, sessions: before and after the intervention)
data_keys.meaning: grip strength at each of the two sessions

data_keys.shape: (10, 2) axes: (participants, sessions: before and after the intervention)
data_keys.meaning: motor cortex thickness measured at the same session

brief.sizes: 10 participants, 2 sessions each (20 measurements in total).
